name: smwmusic-fury-of-the-storm-war-without-purpose
title: Fury of the Storm - War Without Purpose
description:
The incredibly ambient song played at the end of the 4th Place WLDC2022 Entry "Fury of the Storm", played after defeating the boss as well as just in the credits level. Useful for sad (possibly tragic) scenes, or places that just need a good atmosphere.

Written in 7/4 time just for good measure.

Credit is appreciated.
